Karnataka observes statewide shutdown over Cauvery water dispute

Karnataka observed a statewide shutdown on September 26, called by Kannada organizations over the Cauvery water dispute. The shutdown saw widespread protests across the state. Bus services between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, however, continued to operate. The extent of the impact on services was a key point of discussion.
